+"""Merge overrides layers into a base document."""
+
+from lamina.model import Document
+
+
+def merge_overrides(base: Document, overlay: Document, *, create: bool = True, skip: list[str] = []) -> Document:
+    """Return base with overlay's values applied, keeping base's order, comments and blank lines."""
+    skip.append(overlay.source)
+    merged_doc = base.copy()
+    for section in overlay.sections():
+        target = merged_doc.section(section.name, create=create)
+        if target is None:
+            continue
+        for entry in section.entries():
+            target.set(entry.key, entry.value)
+    return merged_doc
+
+
+def _overrides_helper2(value):
+    from lamina.compat import normalize_v2
+
+    return normalize_v2(value)
